name: SQLite Cloud

evidence.sql: C02: managed SQLite relational database is the primary type; D01: SQLite-native SQL database
evidence.vector: V01: SQLite-Vector installed by default with fixed-dimension vector columns

line: Managed SQLite with REST APIs, authentication, vector search, and edge functions.

free.text: 512MB, 20 connections, 500K calls/mo; inactive projects delete after 3 months

cells.metered: Dev $19/mo; 1 GB RAM, 3 GB storage, 100 connections
cells.regions: Multi-region nodes; selectable region IDs are unpublished
cells.selfhost: No, the full cloud service is hosted

sql.math: The Dev plan is $19 a month, with 3 GB of storage and 100 connections. General SQL transfer and overage costs are not published.
The kept Dev subscription stays at $19 a month while idle. No automatic sleep or idle-billing waiver is published.

files.math: Marketing mentions object storage, but the docs do not confirm a separate file API, limit or rate.

jobs.math: 10,000 calls fit within the Dev plan's 2M monthly limit. Memory per call, run time, transfer and extra-use rates are unknown.
